# Ray Cast Hit Normal

Source: [wiki article 4728](../archive/4728.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Ray Cast Hit Normal](../../api/values/ray-cast-hit-normal.md).

<a id="wiki-4728-n1"></a>

- No hit returns direction from end back to start; raycasts ignore Phased Out players.

<a id="wiki-4728-n2"></a>

- Player position arguments resolve two meters above feet; excluded players take precedence over included players.

<a id="wiki-4728-n3"></a>

- Player-owned objects toggle includes barriers/turrets.
